title: Run record frontmatter
description: Validates the YAML frontmatter of experiments/EXP-NNNN-slug/runs/iNN/record.md. Immutable once the iteration ends.

commit.description: Exact commit hash the run used.

dirty.description: True if the working tree was dirty at launch. Dirty runs are flagged by verification.

env.description: Environment snapshot. Suggested keys: lockfile_hash, python, torch, cuda, hardware.

config.description: Resolved config: path in the repo plus a hash of the resolved config, or the config inlined.

setup.description: Materialized setup for this run (not a diff): model, data, benchmarks, hyperparameters.

data.description: Dataset with version/hash and splits, as a string or structured object.

artifacts.description: URIs to external stores (wandb URL, checkpoint URIs, log paths). Heavy artifacts are never committed.

metrics.description: Final numbers. Required by the time status becomes `completed`.

verdict.description: Iteration verdict, set at `analyzed`. `revise` re-enters the loop via the spec-diff approval gate.
